name: slidewright
description: >- Build interactive presentation websites — slide decks projected to a room, controlled by one presenter. Use this skill WHENEVER the user wants to create, build, or design a presentation, slide deck, talk, or "bài thuyết trình / slide / trình chiếu", and also when they ask to add/edit slides, restyle a deck, scaffold a new presentation project, reuse their presentation setup in another repo, control slides from a phone (remote, QR code, "điều khiển slide bằng điện thoại"), or export slides to
